The Galactic Explorer's Guide'' |author=[[Jason Fry]] |cover artist= |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Carlton Books Limited]] |release date=*[[November 14]], [[2019]] {{C|UK}}{{Amazon|domain=co.uk|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Explorers-Guide/dp/1847961029|text=Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide : Fry, Jason}} {{C|UK}} *[[December 20]], 2019 {{C|US}}{{BN|url=w/star-wars-jason-fry/1132547716|text=Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide}} {{C|US}} |type=Hardcover |pages=144 |dimensions=8.2×10.6 inches |weight=1.7 pounds |isbn=9781847961020 |series= |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide''''' is a [[canon]] reference book that is presented as an [[in-universe]] [[Galactic Explorer's Guide|guide]] for traveling across the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[The galaxy|galaxy]]. The book is supplemented by the ''[[Star Wars AR Book Holoscanner]]'' app, which reveals secret contents hidden within the pages. It was written by [[Jason Fry]] and first published by [[Carlton Books Limited]] for the United Kingdom on [[November 14]], [[2019]]. The book was published in the United States on [[December 20]], 2019. ==Publisher's summary== ''This fact-packed book-plus-app is an interactive guide to key planets from the Star Wars galaxy. It contains plenty of information, photographs, and diagrams on the page, and the latest Augmented Reality technology brings many interactive elements to enhance the reading experience.'' ''The traveler's guide to some of the key planets, places, and events from the Star Wars galaxy is a unique tool and a fun reference work. Observe, wonder, and engage with these amazing elements and immerse yourself fully into the galaxy that's far, far away.'' ==Continuity== *''The Galactic Explorer's Guide'' states that [[Padmé Amidala]] succeeded [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] as [[senator]] of [[Naboo]], however ''[[Queen's Shadow]]'' had established that [[Oshadam]] served as senator between the two.''[[Queen's Shadow]]'' *According to Fry, the map included in ''The Galactic Explorer's Guide'' is not entirely accurate, presumably so as to make it look better on the app. As such, several errors—such as the map's boundaries for the [[Western Reaches]] not stretching to [[Jakku]]—are present.{{EmailCite|email=File:AtlasEmail-2025-08-31.png|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-08-31}} ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|imagecat=Images from Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide}} ===Editions=== *{{ISBN|9781847961020}}; [[November 14]], [[2019]]; [[Carlton Books Limited]]; Hardcover ===Cover gallery=== File:SWGalacticExplorersGuide.jpg|Front cover File:SWGalacticExplorersGuide-NoSticker.jpg|Front cover (no "AR" sticker) File:Galactic_Explorers_Guide_Japanese_Cover.jpg|Japanese cover ==Appearances== {{App |characters= *[[2-1B]] *[[Gial Ackbar]] *[[Ubrik Adelhard]] *[[Mas Amedda]] *[[Padmé Amidala Naberrie]] *[[Cassian Jeron Andor]] *[[Wedge Antilles]] *[[Cad Bane]] *[[BB-8]] *[[Tobias Beckett]] *[[Aldar Beedo]] *[[Shara Bey]] {{Imo}} *[[Jar Jar Binks]] {{Po}} *[[Dud Bolt]] *[[C-3PO]] *[[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] *[[Chalmun]] *[[Nalan Cheel]] {{Po}} *[[Chewbacca]] *[[Crag]] {{Po}} *[[Figrin D'an]] *[[Kes Dameron]] {{Imo}} *[[Poe Dameron]] *[[DD-BD]] *[[DK-RA-43]] {{1stm}} *[[Dooku]] *[[Sun'il Ei'de]] {{Po}} *[[Ebe E.
